text: Dida han Lunes, iginpasabot han mga sayantista tikang ha Stanford University School of Medicine an pagkaimbento han usa ka bag-o nga garamiton han pagdayagnos nga pwede makahap-id han mga selyula pinaagi han klase: usa ka gutiay nga pwede ma-print nga chip nga pwede mahimo pinaagi han standard nga inkjet nga mga printer para nga ginbabanabana nga usa ka U.S. nga sentimo an kada tagsa.
eng_text: On Monday, scientists from the Stanford University School of Medicine announced the invention of a new diagnostic tool that can sort cells by type: a tiny printable chip that can be manufactured using standard inkjet printers for possibly about one U.S. cent each.

text: Nasiring an nangunguna nga mga parasaliksik nga pwede ini makagdara ngadto hin sayo nga pag-detect hin kanser, tuberculosis, HIV ngan malaria para han mga pasyente ha hamubo-an-kita nga mga nasud, diin an kahatas-on han pagkasalbar para han mga sakit sugad han kanser ha suso pwede nga magin katunga hadton riko nga mga nasud.
eng_text: Lead researchers say this may bring early detection of cancer, tuberculosis, HIV and malaria to patients in low-income countries, where the survival rates for illnesses such as breast cancer can be half those of richer countries.

text: Bumangga an JAS 39C Gripen ha usa ka runway han mga alas 9:30 am lokal nga oras (0230 UTC) ngan binmuto, hinungdan han pagsarado han airport para han komersyal nga mga paglupad.
eng_text: The JAS 39C Gripen crashed onto a runway at around 9:30 am local time (0230 UTC) and exploded, closing the airport to commercial flights.

text: Nakilal-an an piloto nga hi Squadron Leader Dilokrit Pattavee.
eng_text: The pilot was identified as Squadron Leader Dilokrit Pattavee.

text: Iginsumat han lokal nga media nga nagpulilid an usa ka sarakyan pansunog han airport samtang nagreresponde.
eng_text: Local media reports an airport fire vehicle rolled over while responding.

text: An 28-anyos-an-pangidaron nga hi Vidal tinampo kan Barça tulo ka season na an naglabay, tikang ha Sevilla.
eng_text: 28-year-old Vidal had joined Barça three seasons ago, from Sevilla.

text: Tikang han pagbalhin ha Catalan-nga-kapital, nagmulay hi Vidal hin 49 ka mulay para ha club.
eng_text: Since moving to the Catalan-capital, Vidal had played 49 games for the club.

text: Nagtikang an protesta han mga alas 11:00 lokal nga oras (UTC+1) ha Whitehall tabok han gwardyado han pulis nga entrada han Downing Street, an opisyal nga urukyan han Prime Minister.
eng_text: The protest started around 11:00 local time (UTC+1) on Whitehall opposite the police-guarded entrance to Downing Street, the Prime Minister's official residence.

text: Pagkahuman gud la han alas 11:00, ginbalabgan han mga nagpo-protesta an trapiko ha karwahe nga tikadto ha norte ha Whitehall.
eng_text: Just after 11:00, protesters blocked traffic on the northbound carriage in Whitehall.

text: Han alas 11:20, ginhangyo han pulis an mga nagpo-protesta nga umatras ngadto ha ligid han karsada, nagyayakan nga kinahanglan nira balansehon an ira katungod nga magprotesta han pagtubo han trapiko.
eng_text: At 11:20, the police asked the protesters to move back on to the pavement, stating that they needed to balance the right to protest with the traffic building up.

text: Han mga alas 11:29, bumalhin an protesta tipakadto ha Whitehall, lapos ha Trafalgar Square, kahilera ha Strand, naagi ha Aldwych ngan pasaka ha Kingsway tikadto ha Holborn kon diin an Conservative Party nagkakamayada han ira Spring Forum ha Grand Connaught Rooms nga hotel.
eng_text: Around 11:29, the protest moved up Whitehall, past Trafalgar Square, along the Strand, passing by Aldwych and up Kingsway towards Holborn where the Conservative Party were holding their Spring Forum in the Grand Connaught Rooms hotel.

text: 7–2 an head to head nga rekord ni Nadal kontra han Canadian.
eng_text: Nadal's head to head record against the Canadian is 7–2.

text: Bag-o la hiya nga napirde kontra kan Raonic dida han Brisbane Open.
eng_text: He recently lost against Raonic in the Brisbane Open.

text: Nakuha ni Nadal an 88% nga net points dida han match nga nakadaog hin 76 ka puntos dida han siyahan nga serbe.
eng_text: Nadal bagged 88% net points in the match winning 76 points in the first serve.

text: Pagkatima han match, nagsiring an Hadi han Clay, "Excited la ako tungod han paghibalik ha final nga mga round han pinaka-importante nga mga event. Aanhi ako para sarihan nga madaog ini."
eng_text: After the match, King of Clay said, "I am just excited about being back in the final rounds of the most important events. I am here to try to win this."

text: An "Panama Papers" usa ka iginbansag nga termino para hiton mga dyes milyones nga mga dokumento tikang ha Panamanian nga law firm an Mossack Fonseca, nga ginpalusot ngado ha press dida han spring 2016.
eng_text: "Panama Papers" is an umbrella term for roughly ten million documents from Panamanian law firm Mossack Fonseca, leaked to the press in spring 2016.

text: Iginpakita han mga dokumento nga katorse ka bangko an nagbulig ha riko nga mga kliyente para tagoon an bilyones nga US nga mga dolyares nga karikohan para makalikay ha mga buwis ngan iba pa nga mga regulasyon.
eng_text: The documents showed fourteen banks helped wealthy clients hide billions of US dollars of wealth to avoid taxes and other regulations.

text: An British nga dyaryo nga The Guardian nagsagdon nga kontrolado han Deutsche Bank an mga ikatulo ka parte han 1200 nga mga kompanya han shell nga gingamit basi mabuhat ini.
eng_text: British newspaper The Guardian suggested Deutsche Bank controlled roughly a third of the 1200 shell companies used to accomplish this.

text: Mayda mga protesta ha bug-os nga kalibotan, pipira nga kriminal nga mga prosekusyon, ngan pareho nangag-resign an mga lider han mga gobyerno han Iceland ngan Pakistan.
eng_text: There were protests worldwide, several criminal prosecutions, and the leaders of the governments of Iceland and Pakistan both resigned.

text: Natawo ha Hong Kong, nag-eskwela hi Ma ha New York University ngan Harvard Law School ngan anay nakapot hin usa ka American permanent resident nga "green card".
eng_text: Born in Hong Kong, Ma studied at New York University and Harvard Law School and once held an American permanent resident "green card".

text: Nagsiring hi Hsieh dida han eleksyon nga bangin hi Ma pumalagiw ha nasud ha panahon hin usa krisis.
eng_text: Hsieh implied during the election that Ma might flee the country during a time of crisis.

text: Nangatadongan gihap hi Hsieh nga an photogenic nga Ma mas kaurog ha istilo kontra han substansya.
eng_text: Hsieh also argued that the photogenic Ma was more style than substance.

text: Bisan pa hini nga mga akusasyon, nagdaog dayon hi Ma ha usa ka plataporma nga nagpapasiugda hin mas duok nga relasyon ha mainland China.
eng_text: Despite these accusations, Ma won handily on a platform advocating closer ties with the Chinese mainland.

text: An Player of the Day yana nga adlaw amo hi Alex Ovechkin han Washington Capitals.
eng_text: Today's Player of the Day is Alex Ovechkin of the Washington Capitals.

text: Mayda niya 2 ka goal ngan 2 ka assist ha 5-3 nga pagdaog han Washington kontra han Atlanta Thrashers.
eng_text: He had 2 goals and 2 assists in Washington's 5-3 win over the Atlanta Thrashers.

text: An siyahan nga assist ni Ovechkin han gab-i amo an nakapadaog han mulay nga goal ni bag-ohan nga hi Nicklas Backstrom;
eng_text: Ovechkin's first assist of the night was on the game-winning goal by rookie Nicklas Backstrom;

text: an iya ikaduha nga goal han gab-i amo an iya ika-60 han season, nahimo nga pinakasiyahan nga magmurulay para maka-iskor hin 60 o dugang pa nga mga goal ha usa ka season tikang han 1995-96, kon diin hi Jaromir Jagr ngan Mario Lemieux kada tagsa nakakab-ot hito nga milestone.
eng_text: his second goal of the night was his 60th of the season, becoming the first player to score 60 or more goals in a season since 1995-96, when Jaromir Jagr and Mario Lemieux each reached that milestone.

text: Nagraranggo hi Batten ha ika-190 ha 2008 nga lista han 400 nga Pinakariko nga mga Amerikano nga mayda ginbabanabana nga $2.3 bilyones nga karikohan.
eng_text: Batten was ranked 190th on the 2008 400 Richest Americans list with an estimated fortune of $2.3 billion.

text: Naggradwar hiya tikang ha College of Arts & Sciences ha University of Virginia han 1950 nga usa ka mahinungdanon nga donor para hiton nga institusyon.
eng_text: He graduated from the College of Arts & Sciences of the University of Virginia in 1950 and was a significant donor to that institution.

text: Ginpalarab dida han usa ka riot an Abu Ghraib nga prisohan han Iraq.
eng_text: Iraq's Abu Ghraib prison has been set alight during a riot.

text: Nahimo nga bantog an prisohan han madiskobrehan an pag-abuso ha mga priso dida pagkatapos han pagliwan han mga pwersa han US.
eng_text: The jail became notorious after prisoner abuse was discovered there after US forces took over.

text: Nabangga hi Piquet Jr. dida han 2008 Singapore Grand Prix pagkatapos gud la han sayo nga pit stop para kan Fernando Alonso, nga nagpagawas han safety nga sarakyan.
eng_text: Piquet Jr. crashed in the 2008 Singapore Grand Prix just after an early pit stop for Fernando Alonso, bringing out the safety car.

text: Samtang an mga awto nga nauuna kan Alonso sinmulod para han gasolina ha ilarom han safety nga sarakyan, sinmaka hiya ha igbaw han grupo para kuhaon an pagdarag-an.
eng_text: As the cars ahead of Alonso went in for fuel under the safety car, he moved up the pack to take victory.

text: Gintangtang hi Piquet Jr. pagkatima han 2009 Hungarian Grand Prix.
eng_text: Piquet Jr. was sacked after the 2009 Hungarian Grand Prix.

text: Dida han eksakto nga alas 8:46 a.m. nagmingaw an kabug-osan han syudad, nagtigaman han eksakto nga punto nga an siyahan nga jet nakaigo han iya target.
eng_text: At exactly 8:46 a.m. a hush fell across the city, marking the exact moment the first jet struck its target.

text: Duha ka siga hin suga an iginbutang para itutok ha langit ha bug-os nga gab-i.
eng_text: Two beams of light have been rigged up to point skywards overnight.

text: Nagpapadayon an pagtukod para han lima nga bag-o nga mga skyscraper ha site, nga mayda sentro hin transportasyon ngan memorial park ha butnga.
eng_text: Construction is ongoing for five new skyscrapers at the site, with a transportation center and memorial park in the middle.

text: An PBS nga salida may-ada sobra duha ka dosena nga Emmy awards, ngan an pagpasalida hito mas halipotay la han Sesame Street ngan Mister Roger’s Neighborhood.
eng_text: The PBS show has more than two-dozen Emmy awards, and its run is shorter only than Sesame Street and Mister Rogers' Neighborhood.

text: Nakasentro ha usa ka tema han usa ka espisipiko nga libro an kada episode han pasalida ngan uusisahon ito nga tema pinaagi hin damo nga mga istorya.
eng_text: Each episode of the show would focus on a theme in a specific book and then explore that theme through multiple stories.

text: An kada pasalida naghahatag liwat hin mga rekomendasyon kon ano nga mga libro an angay bilngon han mga kabataan kon makadto hira ha library.
eng_text: Each show would also provide recommendations for books that children should look for when they went to their library.

text: Hi John Grant, tikang ha WNED Buffalo (an nangunguna nga estasyon han Reading Rainbow) nagsiring nga “An Reading Rainbow nagtutdo ha mga bata kon kay ano nga angay hira magbasa,... an paghigugma hiton pagbasa - [an pasalida] nag-aaghat ha mga bata nga kumuha hin libro ngan magbasa.”
eng_text: John Grant, from WNED Buffalo (Reading Rainbow's home station) said "Reading Rainbow taught kids why to read,... the love of reading — [the show] encouraged kids to pick up a book and to read."

text: Natuod an iba, upod na hi John Grant, nga an paghinay han pundo ngan pagbalhin han pilosopiya hiton pang-edukasyon nga pag-programa ha telebisyon binulig ha pagtapos han serye.
eng_text: It is believed by some, including John Grant, that both the funding crunch and a shift in the philosophy of educational television programming contributed to ending the series.

text: An bagyo, nahimumutang mga 645 milya (1040 km) katundan han Cape Verde nga isla, in may posibilidad nga matunaw ugsa makaperwisyo ha bisan diin nga lugar ha katunaan, siring han mga forecaster.
eng_text: The storm, situated about 645 miles (1040 km) west of the Cape Verde islands, is likely to dissipate before threatening any land areas, forecasters say.

text: Ha pagkayana hi Fred mayda hangin nga 105 ka milya kada oras (165 km/h) ngan nagios tipakadto ha norte-katundan.
eng_text: Fred currently has winds of 105 miles per hour (165 km/h) and is moving towards the northwest.

text: Hi Fred an pinakamakusog nga tropikal nga cyclone tikang han katikang nga narekord harayo hin duro ha sur ngan sinirangan ha Atlantic tikang han pagtikang han satellite imagery, ngan ikatulo nga dako nga hurricane ha rekord ha sinirangan han 35°W.
eng_text: Fred is the strongest tropical cyclone ever recorded so far south and east in the Atlantic since the advent of satellite imagery, and only the third major hurricane on record east of 35°W.

text: Dida han Septembre 24, 1759, pumirma hi Arthur Guinness hin usa ka 9,000 ka tuig nga plete para han St James' Gate Brewery ha Dublin, Ireland.
eng_text: On September 24, 1759, Arthur Guinness signed a 9,000 year lease for the St James' Gate Brewery in Dublin, Ireland.

text: Paglabay hin 250 ka tuig, dumako an Guinness ngadto han usa ka pan-kalibotan nga negosyo nga nakaganansya hin 10 bilyones ka euro (US$14.7 bilyones) kada tuig.
eng_text: 250 years later, Guinness has grown to a global business that turns over 10 billion euros (US$14.7 billion) every year.

text: Hi Jonny Reid, an igkasi-drayber para han A1GP New Zealand nga team, nakahimo hin kasaysayan yana nga adlaw pinaagi han legal nga pagmaneho hin pinakamalaksi ha bawbaw han 48-anyos-an-edad nga Auckland Harbour Bridge, han New Zealand.
eng_text: Jonny Reid, co-driver for the A1GP New Zealand team, today made history by driving the fastest over the 48-year-old Auckland Harbour Bridge, New Zealand, legally.

text: Nahimo ni Mr Reid nga magdrayb han A1GP nga awto han New Zealand, an Black Beauty ha kalaksi nga labaw ha 160 km/h pito ka beses ha bawbaw han tulay.
eng_text: Mr Reid managed to drive the New Zealand's A1GP car, Black Beauty at speeds over 160km/h seven times over the bridge.

text: Ginkurian an pulis han New Zealand paggamit han ira speed radar nga mga pusil para makit-an kon ano kalaksi an padalagan ni Mr Reid tungod han kahamubo ni Black Beauty, ngan an amo la nga higayon nga naorasan han pulis hi Mr Reid dida han pagmenor hini ngadto han 160 km/h.
eng_text: The New Zealand police had trouble using their speed radar guns to see how fast Mr Reid was going because of how low Black Beauty is, and the only time the police managed to clock Mr Reid was when he slowed down to 160km/h.

text: Dida han naglabay nga 3 ka bulan, sobra ha 80 nga mga arestado an ginbuhian tikang ha Central Booking nga pasilidad nga waray pormal nga ginkasuhan.
eng_text: In the last 3 months, over 80 arrestees were released from the Central Booking facility without being formally charged.

text: Dida han Abril yana nga tuig, usa nga temporary restraining order an igin-isyu ni Judge Glynn kontra han pasilidad para igpatuman an pagpagawas hadton mga ginpriso hin sobra 24 oras katima han pagpasulod ha ira nga waray makakarawat hin usa nga hearing han usa nga komisyoner hin korte.
eng_text: In April this year, a temporary restaining order was issued by Judge Glynn against the facility to enforce the release of those held more than 24 hours after their intake who did not receive a hearing by a court commissioner.

text: Magpaplastar an komisyoner hin piyansa, kon ihatag, ngan ginpopormal an mga reklamo nga ginpapasaka han nag-aresto nga opisyal. Pagkatapos isusulod an mga reklamo ha sistema han kompyuter han estado kon diin ginsusubay an kaso.
eng_text: The commissioner sets bail, if granted, and formalizes the charges filed by the arresting officer. The charges are then entered into the state's computer system where the case is tracked.

text: Nagtitigaman gihap an hearing han petsa para han katungod han suspetsado para han usa ka paspas nga litigasyon.
eng_text: The hearing also marks the date for the suspect’s right to a speedy trial.

text: Hi Peter Costello, an Australian nga treasurer ngan an pinaka-posible nga sumaliwan kan Prime Minister John Howard kumo lider han Liberal nga partido naghatag han iya suporta ha luyo han usa ka nuclear power nga industriya ha Australia.
eng_text: Peter Costello, Australian treasurer and the man most likely to succeed Prime Minister John Howard as Liberal party leader has thrown his support behind a nuclear power industry in Australia.

text: Nagsiring hi Mr Costello ha panahon nga an nuclear power generation mahimo nga magin barato, kinahanglan ipadayon han Australia an paggamit hini.
eng_text: Mr Costello said that when nuclear power generation becomes economically viable, Australia should pursue its use.

text: "Kon mahimo ini nga komersyal, kinahanglan mayda kita hini. Tungod hini, waray ha-prinsipyo nga pagsupak ha nukleyar nga enerhiya" siring ni Mr Costello.
eng_text: "If it becomes commercial, we should have it. That is, there's no in-principle objection to nuclear energy" Mr Costello said.

text: Sumala kan Ansa, "nababaraka an pulis han usa ka padis hin top-level nga mga hit nga nahahadlukan nira nga bangin magpatikang hin bug-os nga magkasurunod nga girra.
eng_text: According to Ansa, "police were concerned by a couple of top-level hits they feared might spark a full-blown war of succession.

text: Nagsiring an pulis nga nakakabawbaw hi Lo Piccolo tungod dati hiya nga tuo-nga-kamot ni Provenzano ha Palermo ngan an iya mas dako nga kabatid nakapadaog ha iya han respeto han kalagsan nga henerasyon han mga boss samtang naglalanat hira han palisiya ni Provenzano nga pagpabilin ha pinakahamubo nga maaakos samtang ginpapakusog an ira network han gahum.
eng_text: Police said Lo Piccolo had the upper hand because he had been Provenzano's right-hand man in Palermo and his greater experience won him the respect of the older generation of bosses as they pursued Provenzano's policy of keeping as low as possible while strengthening their power network.

text: Nagkaririndahan ni Provenzano ini nga mga boss dida han gintima niya an ginduduso-ni-Riina nga gira kontra han estado nga nag-awat han mga kinabuhi nira Mafia crusaders Giovanni Falcone ngan Paolo Borsellino dida han 1992."
eng_text: These bosses had been reined in by Provenzano when he put an end to the Riina-driven war against the state that claimed the lives of Mafia crusaders Giovanni Falcone and Paolo Borsellino in 1992."

text: Ginpadayag ni Apple CEO Steve Jobs an device pinaagi han paglakat ha entablado ngan pagkuha han iPhone ha bursa han iya saruwal.
eng_text: Apple CEO Steve Jobs unveiled the device by walking onto the stage and taking the iPhone out of his jeans pocket.

text: Dida han iya 2 ka oras nga pagyakan nagsiring hiya nga "Yana nga adlaw uutrohon pag-imbento han Apple an telepono, Maghihimo kita hin kasaysayan yana nga adlaw".
eng_text: During his 2 hour speech he stated that "Today Apple is going to reinvent the phone, We are going to make history today".

text: An Brazil amo an pinakadaku nga Romano Katoliko nga Nasud ha Tuna, ngan marig-on nga gintipahan han Simbahan han Romano Katoliko an legalisasyon han pag-asawa han magkapariho an sekso ha nasud.
eng_text: Brazil is the largest Roman Catholic country on Earth, and the Roman Catholic Church has consistently opposed the legalization of same-sex marriage in the country.

text: Gindebate han Nasyonal nga Kongreso han Brazil an legalisasyon hin 10 ka tuig, ngan iton nga sibil nga mga pag-asawa ha pagkayana legal la ha Rio Grande do Sul.
eng_text: The National Congress of Brazil has debated legalization for 10 years, and such civil marriages are currently only legal in Rio Grande do Sul.

text: Ginpahimugna an orihinal nga bill han dati nga mayor han São Paulo, nga hi Marta Suplicy. An iginmuhang nga balaod, kahuman bag-uhon, aada na yana ha mga kamot ni Roberto Jefferson.
eng_text: The original bill was drafted by former mayor of São Paulo, Marta Suplicy. The proposed legislation, after being amended, is now in the hands of Roberto Jefferson.

text: Naglalaom an mga nagprotesta nga makakolekta hin usa ka petisyon han 1.2 ka milyon nga mga pirma para igpresentar ha Nasyonal nga Kongreso ha Nobyembre.
eng_text: Protesters hope to collect a petition of 1.2 million signatures to present to the National Congress in November.

text: Kahuman maklaro nga damo nga mga pamilya an namimiling hin legal nga bulig para makaato han mga pagpaiwas, usa ka miting an ginhimo dida han Marso 20 ha East Bay Community Law Center para han mga biktima han housing scam.
eng_text: After it became apparent that many families were seeking legal help to fight the evictions, a meeting was held on March 20 at the East Bay Community Law Center for the victims of the housing scam.

text: Han magtikang an mga umurukoy mag-istorya han nahitabo ha ira, kaurogan han mga pamilya nga nahidabi tigda la nga nakasantop nga ginkawat ni Carolyn Wilson han OHA an ira mga deposito nga panseguridad, ngan pumalagiw pagawas han bungto.
eng_text: When the tenants started sharing what had occurred to them, most of the families involved suddenly realized that Carolyn Wilson of the OHA had stolen their security deposits, and skipped out of town.

text: Natoo an mga umurukoy ha Lockwood Gardens nga bangin mayda pa lain nga 40 ka pamilya o dugang pa nga papaiwason, tungod kay nahibaroan nira nga nag-iimbestigar gihapon an pulis han OHA han iba nga mga propyedad han pampubliko nga pabalay ha Oakland nga bangin nasakban han housing scam.
eng_text: Tenants at Lockwood Gardens believe that there may be another 40 families or more to face eviction, since they learned that OHA police are also investigating other public housing properties in Oakland that may be caught up in the housing scam.

text: Ginkansela han banda an pasalida ha War Memorial Stadium han Maui, nga iginplastar para tambongan hin 9,000 ka tawo, ngan nangaro hin pasaylo ha mga fans.
eng_text: The band canceled the show at Maui's War Memorial Stadium, which was set to be attended by 9,000 people, and apologized to fans.

text: An kumpaniya nga nagdudumara han banda, an HK Management Inc., waray maghatag hin pauna nga rason dida han ira pagkansela han Septyembre 20, pero ginbasol an logistical nga mga rason kinabuwasan.
eng_text: The band's management company, HK Management Inc., gave no initial reason when they canceled on September 20, but blamed logistical reasons by the next day.

text: An sikat nga Griego nga mga abogado, nga hira Sakis Kechagioglou ngan George Nikolakopoulos ginpriso ha prisohan han Korydallus han Athens, tungod kay nahisabtan nga salaan hira hin graft ngan korapsyon.
eng_text: The famous Greek lawyers, Sakis Kechagioglou and George Nikolakopoulos have been imprisoned in the Athens' jail of Korydallus, as they were found guilty of graft and corruption.

text: Tungod hini, nagkaada hin daku nga iskandalo ha sulod han legal nga komunidad han Griego pinaagi han pagkadayag han iligal nga mga aksyon nga nahimo han mga huwes, mga abogado, mga solicitor ngan mga attorney dida han nag-agi nga mga tuig.
eng_text: As a result of this, a big scandal within the Greek legal community has been raised through the exposure of illegal actions that judges, lawyers, solicitors and attorneys have done during the previous years.

text: Pira ka semana an naglabay, kahuman an pagmantala han impormasyon ni journalist Makis Triantafylopoulos ha iya sikat nga pasalida ha Telebisyon nga "Zoungla" ha Alpha TV, an membro han Parliamento ngan abogado, nga hi Petros Mantouvalos linmusad ha pwesto tungod han paghidabi han mga membro han iya opisina ha iligal nga graft ngan korapsyon.
eng_text: A few weeks ago, after the information published by the journalist Makis Triantafylopoulos in his popular Television show "Zoungla" in Alpha TV, the member of Parliament and lawyer, Petros Mantouvalos was abdicated as members of his office had been involved in illegal graft and corruption.

text: Dugang pa, napriso an nangunguna nga huwes nga hi Evangelos Kalousis tungod kay nasabtan nga salaan hiya hin korapsyon ngan tikaraot nga batasan.
eng_text: Moreover, top judge Evangelos Kalousis is imprisoned as he found guilty of corruption and degenerate behaviour.

text: Binmaribad la hi Roberts pagyakan tungod ha iya pagtoo kon san-o nagtikang an kinabuhi, usa ka importante nga pakiana kon naghuhunahuna han etika han pagpunit, nagsisiring nga magigin unethical an pagkomento ha mga espesipiko han sugad nga mga kaso.
eng_text: Roberts flatly refused to say about when he believes life begins, an important question when considering the ethics of abortion, saying that it would be unethical to comment on the specifics of likely cases.

text: Pero, iya gin-utro an iya nauna nga pamahayag nga an Roe v. Wade asya an "gintuhay nga balaud hin tuna", ginkaklaro an importansya han magkauruyon nga mga paghukom han Korte Suprema.
eng_text: He did, however, reiterate his earlier statement that Roe v. Wade was the "settled law of the land", emphasizing the importance of consistent Supreme Court rulings.

text: Iya gihapon ginkumpirma nga natuod hiya han ginpasiugda nga katungod ha pagkapribado nga asya an gintatapuran han desisyon ni Roe.
eng_text: He also confirmed that he believed in the implied right to privacy which the Roe decision depended upon.

text: Nagtapos an Maroochydore ha pungkay han hagdanan, sais puntos an lamang kan Noosa ha ikaduha.
eng_text: Maroochydore had finished on top of the ladder, six points clear of Noosa in second.

text: Makikita an duha ka magkaatbang ha major semi final kun diin gindalaganan han Noosa an mga daog hin 11 puntos.
eng_text: The two sides would meet in the major semi final where Noosa ran out winners by 11 points.

text: Katima ginpirdi han Maroochydore an Caboolture ha Preliminary Final.

eng_text: The case was prosecuted in Virginia because it is the home to the leading internet service provider AOL, the company who instigated the charges.

text: Iginpahayag ni Dr. Lee an iya kabaraka mahitungod han mga report nga an mga bata ha Turkey natapnan na yana hin A(H5N1) avian influenza virus nga diri nagkakasakit.
eng_text: Dr. Lee also expressed his concern about reports that children in Turkey have now become infected with the A(H5N1) avian influenza virus without becoming ill.

eng_text: There is concern that patients may continue to infect more people by going through their daily routines if the flu symptoms remain mild.

eng_text: Leslie Aun, a spokesperson for the Komen Foundation, said the organization adopted a new rule that does not allow grants or funding to be awarded to organizations that are under legal investigation.

eng_text: Komen's policy disqualified Planned Parenthood due to a pending investigation on how Planned Parenthood spends and reports its money that is being conducted by Representative Cliff Stearns.

eng_text: Former Massachusetts governor Mitt Romney won the Florida Republican Party presidential primary election on Tuesday with over 46 percent of the vote.

eng_text: As a winner-takes-all state, Florida awarded all fifty of its delegates to Romney, pushing him ahead as the front-runner for the Republican Party nomination.

text: Nagsiring an mga nag-andam han protesta nga harani 100,000 ka tawo an umabot ha mga siyudad han Germany sugad han Berlin, Cologne, Hamburg, ngan Hanover.
eng_text: Organisers of the protest said about 100,000 people turned up in German cities such as Berlin, Cologne, Hamburg, and Hanover.

eng_text: Protests also took place in Paris, Sofia in Bulgaria, Vilnius in Lithuania, Valetta in Malta, Tallinn in Estonia, and Edinburgh and Glasgow in Scotland.

eng_text: Latvia and Slovakia have both delayed the process of joining ACTA.

eng_text: Animal Liberation and the Royal Society for the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals (RSPCA) are again calling for the mandatory installation of CCTV cameras in all Australian abattoirs.

text: Ginsiring han nangunguna nga inspektor han RSPCA New South Wales nga hi David O'Shannessy ha ABC nga an pagbantay ngan pagpanginano ha mga irihawan kinahanglan magin komon ha Australia.
eng_text: RSPCA New South Wales chief inspector David O'Shannessy told the ABC that surveillance and inspections of abattoirs should be commonplace in Australia.

eng_text: "The CCTV would certainly send a strong signal to those people working with animals that their welfare is of the highest priority."

eng_text: The United States Geological Survey international earthquake map showed no earthquakes in Iceland in the week prior.

eng_text: The Icelandic Meteorological Office also reported no earthquake activity in the Hekla area in the past 48 hours.

eng_text: The significant earthquake activity resulting in the phase change had took place on March 10 on the northeast side of the volcano's summit caldera.

eng_text: Dark clouds unrelated to any volcanic activity were reported at the base of the mountain.

eng_text: The clouds presented the potential for confusion as to whether an actual eruption had taken place.

text: An Luno may-ada 120-160 cubic metres hin fuel nga karga han naguba ini ngan iginduso ini han makusog nga hangin ngan mga balod ha breakwater.
eng_text: The Luno had 120–160 cubic metres of fuel aboard when it broke down and high winds and waves pushed it into the breakwater.

eng_text: The failure of the second sentence, which proposes to ban same-sex civil unions, could possibly open the door for civil unions in the future.

text: Ha pagsunod ha proseso, an HJR-3 in utro nga papanginanoon han sunod nga mapipili nga lehislatura ha 2015 o di ngani ha 2016 para magpabilin ha proseso.
eng_text: Following the process, HJR-3 will be reviewed again by the next elected legislature in either 2015 or 2016 to remain in process.

eng_text: Vautier's achievements outside of directing include a hunger strike in 1973 against what he viewed as political censorship.

text: Han 1960s bumalik hiya ha bag-o la nga na-independente nga Algeria para magtutdo hin film directing.
eng_text: In the 1960s he headed back to newly-independent Algeria to teach film directing.

text: An Hapon nga judoka nga hi Hitoshi Saito, nakadaog hin duha ka bulawan nga medalya ha Olympic, in namatay ha edad nga 54.
eng_text: Japanese judoka Hitoshi Saito, winner of two Olympic gold medals, has died at the age of 54.

eng_text: The cause of death was announced as intrahepatic bile duct cancer.

text: Namatay hiya ha Osaka hadton Martes.
eng_text: He died in Osaka on Tuesday.

eng_text: As well as a former Olympic and World champion, Saito was the All Japan Judo Federation training committee chairman at the time of his death.

text: Diri maubos ha 100 ka tawo an tumambong han party, para saurugon an siyahan nga anibersaryo han mag-asawa nga ginkasal han naglabay nga tuig.
eng_text: At least 100 people had attended the party, in order to celebrate the first anniversary of a couple whose wedding was held last year.

eng_text: A formal anniversary event was scheduled for a later date, officials said.

eng_text: The couple had married in Texas one year ago and came to Buffalo to celebrate with friends and relatives.

eng_text: Karno is a well-known but controversial English tutor who taught under Modern Education and King's Glory who claimed to have 9,000 students at the peak of his career.

eng_text: In his notes he used words which some parents considered coarse, and he reportedly used profanity in class.

eng_text: Modern Education accused him of printing large advertisements on buses without authorisation and lying by saying that he was the chief English tutor.

eng_text: He has also been accused previously of copyright infringement, but was not charged.

eng_text: A former student said that he 'used slang in class, taught dating skills in notes, and was just like the students' friend.'

text: Ha nakalabay nga tulo ka dekada, bisan pa ha pagpabilin ha komunista nga estado, an China nagkaada pag-uswag ha ekonomiya.
eng_text: During the last three decades, despite officially remaining a communist state, China has developed a market economy.

text: An mga nauna nga reporma ha ekonomiya nahitabo ilarom han pagmando ni Deng Xiaoping.
eng_text: The first economic reforms were made under the leadership of Deng Xiaoping.

text: Tikang hadto, an kadako han ekonomiya han China tumubo hin 90 ka beses.
eng_text: Since then, China's economic size has grown by 90 times.

eng_text: For the first time, last year China exported more cars than Germany and surpassed the United States as the biggest market for this industry.

text: Posible magin mas dako an GDP han China kontra ha Estados Unidos ha sulod hin duha ka dekada.
eng_text: China's GDP could be larger than the United States within two decades.

text: Nabug-os ha este nga bahin han Atlantic Ocean an Tropical Storm Danielle, an ika-upat nga gin-ngaranan nga bagyo han 2010 Atlantic hurricane season.
eng_text: Tropical Storm Danielle, fourth named storm of the 2010 Atlantic hurricane season, has formed in the eastern Atlantic Ocean.

text: An bagyo, nahimumutang ha ginbabanabana 3,000 ka milya tikang ha Miami, Florida, nga may kakusgon han hangin ngada ha 40 mph (64 kph).
eng_text: The storm, located approximately 3,000 miles from Miami, Florida, has maximum sustained winds of 40 mph (64 kph).

text: An mga siyentista ha National Hurricane Center nagtagna nga hi Danielle magigin usa nga makusog nga bagyo ha Miyerkules.
eng_text: Scientists at the National Hurricane Center predict that Danielle will strengthen to a hurricane by Wednesday.

text: Samtang an bagyo harayo pa mag landfall, nagpabilin nga makuri turutimbangon an posible nga epekto han pag-igo hini ha Estados Unidos o Caribbean.
eng_text: As the storm is far from landfall, it remains difficult to assess potential impact to the United States or Caribbean.

text: Natawo ha kapital han Croatia, Zagreb, hi Bobek nakakuha hin kasikatan samtang nagmumulay para ha Partizan Belgrade.
eng_text: Born in the Croatian capital, Zagreb, Bobek gained fame while playing for Partizan Belgrade.

text: Umapi hiya ha ira han 1945 ngan nagpadayon hangtod 1958.
eng_text: He joined them in 1945 and stayed until 1958.

eng_text: During his time with the team, he scored 403 goals in 468 appearances.

text: Waray iba pa nga nakabuhat hin damo nga mga appearance o naka puntos hin damo nga goal para ha club labot kan Bobek.
eng_text: No one else has ever made more appearances or scored more goals for the club than Bobek.

text: Han 1995 ginbutosan hiya sugad nga pinakamakarit nga paramulay ha historya han Partizan.
eng_text: In 1995 he was voted the best player in Partizan's history.

eng_text: The celebrations started with a special show by the world-renowned group Cirque du Soleil.

text: Ginsundan ini han Istanbul State Symphony Orchestra, an banda nga Janissary, ngan an mga singer nga hira Fatih Erkoc ngan Muslum Gurses.
eng_text: It was followed by the Istanbul State Symphony Orchestra, a Janissary band, and the singers Fatih Erkoç and Müslüm Gürses.

eng_text: Then Whirling Dervishes took to the stage.

eng_text: Turkish diva Sezen Aksu performed with the Italian tenor Alessandro Safina and Greek singer Haris Alexiou.

eng_text: To finish, Turkish dance group Fire of Anatolia performed the show "Troy".

text: Hi Peter Lenz, usa nga 13-anyos nga manrurumba ha motorsiklo, in namatay kahuman mahalakip ha disgrasya ha Indianapolis Motor Speedway.
eng_text: Peter Lenz, a 13-year-old motorcycle racer, has died after being involved in a crash at the Indianapolis Motor Speedway.

text: Samtang hiya nag wawarm-up, nahulog hi Lenz ha iya bike, ngan naligis han iya igkasi magrurumba nga hi Xavier Zayat.
eng_text: While on his warm-up lap, Lenz fell off his bike, and was then struck by fellow racer Xavier Zayat.

text: Ginpanginano dayon hiya han mga on-track medical staff ngan iginbiyahe ha lokal nga ospital kon diin waray pag-iha namatay hiya.
eng_text: He was immediately attended to by the on-track medical staff and transported to a local hospital where he later died.

text: Hi Zayat waray kasamari han aksidente.
eng_text: Zayat was unhurt in the accident.

eng_text: Regarding the global financial situation, Zapatero continued by saying that "the financial system is a part of the economy, a crucial part.

eng_text: We have a year-long financial crisis, which has had its most acute moment in the past two months, and I think now the financial markets are beginning to recover."

eng_text: Last week, Naked News announced that it would dramatically increase its international language mandate to news reporting, with three new broadcasts.

text: Nagrereport na ha English ngan Japanese, an bug-os kalibotan nga organisasyon magpapatikang hin mga programa ha Espanyol, Italyano, ngan Korean nga linggwahe, para ha telebisyon, web, ngan ha mga mobile device.
eng_text: Already reporting in English and Japanese, the global organization is launching Spanish, Italian, and Korean-language programs, for television, the web, and mobile devices.

text: Maopay nala waray nahitabo ha akon, pero nakita ko an makaharadlok nga eksena, samtang ginpapanbuong han mga tawo an mga bintana para makagawas.
eng_text: "Luckily nothing happened to me, but I saw a macabre scene, as people tried to break windows in order to get out.

text: Ginbinalbag han mga tawo an bintana gamit an mga lingkuran, kondi diri nabubuong an mga bintana.
eng_text: People were hitting the panes with chairs, but the windows were unbreakable.

eng_text: One of the panes finally broke, and they started to get out by the window," said survivor Franciszek Kowal.

text: An mga bitoon naghahatag hin kalamrag ngan kapaso tungod han enerhiya nga nahihimo kon an hydrogen ngan atom igintampo (o nagtampo) para makahimo hin mas mabug-at nga elemento.
eng_text: Stars give off light and heat because of the energy made when hydrogen atoms are merged (or fused) together to form heavier elements.

text: An mga siyentista in nagtatrabaho para maghimo hin usa nga reactor nga puydi makahimo hin enerhiya ha parehas nga paagi.
eng_text: Scientists are working to create a reactor that can make energy in the same way.

eng_text: This, however, is a very hard problem to solve and will take many years before we see useful fusion reactors built.

text: An bakal nga dagom nalutaw ha igbaw han tubig tungod han tensyon ha igbaw.
eng_text: The steel needle floats on top of the water because of surface tension.

text: Nahihitabo an tensyon ha igbaw tungod nga an mga molekula han tubig ha igbaw han tubig in labaw nga nadadani ha usa-kag-usa kontra ha mga molekula han hangin ha igbaw nira.
eng_text: Surface tension happens because the water molecules at the surface of the water are strongly attracted to each other more than they are to the air molecules above them.

text: An mga molekula han tubig in naghihimo hin diri nakikita nga panit ha igbaw han tubig nga nagtutugot han mga butang sugad han dagom nga lumutaw ha igbaw han tubig.
eng_text: The water molecules make an invisible skin on the water’s surface that allows things like the needle to float on top of the water.

text: An blade ha usa nga moderno nga ice skate may-ada doble nga gilid nga may hiwi nga buho ha mga butnga hini. An duha nga ligid nagtutugot para ha usa nga mas maopay nga pagkapot han ice, bisan kon humilig.
eng_text: The blade on a modern ice skate has a double edge with a concave hollow between them. The two edges allow for a better grasp of the ice, even when tilted.

text: Tungod kay an ubos han blade kay medyo naka kurba, samtang an blade nahilig ha usa nga dapit or ha kaluyo, an ligid nga nakasumpay ha ice in kurbado gihapon.
eng_text: Because the bottom of the blade is slightly curved, as the blade tilts to one side or the other, the edge which is in contact with the ice also curves.

text: Ini in nagigin hinungdan nga bumirik an skater. Kon an mga skate humilig ngadto ha too, an skater maliko ha too, kon an skate humilig ngadto ha wala, an skater in maliko ha wala.
eng_text: This causes the skater to turn. If the skates tilt to the right, the skater turns right, if the skates tilt to the left, the skater turns left.

text: Basi bumalik ha ira dati nga lebel han enerhiya, kinahanglan nira tanggalon an sobra nga enerhiya nga nakuha nira tikang ha lamrag.
eng_text: To return to their previous energy level, they must get rid of the extra energy they got from the light.

text: Ginhihimo nira ini pinaagi ha pagpagawas hin gutiay nga lamrag nga gintatawag nga "photon".
eng_text: They do this by emitting a tiny particle of light called a "photon".

text: Gintatawag han mga siyentista ini nga proseso nga "stimulated emission of radiation" tungod kay an mga atom nabubuhi ha masilaw nga lamrag, ngan an lamrag usa nga klase hin radiation.
eng_text: Scientists call this process "stimulated emission of radiation" because the atoms are stimulated by the bright light, causing the emission of a photon of light, and light is a type of radiation.

text: An masunod nga litrato nagpapakita han mga atom nga nagpapagawas hin mga photon. Syempre, ha tinuod an mga photon in mas gutiay kontra ha aada ha litrato.
eng_text: The next picture shows the atoms emitting photons. Of course, in reality photons are a lot smaller than those in the picture.

text: An mga photon in mas gutiay pa ha mga butang nga naghihimo ha mga atom!
eng_text: Photons are even smaller than the stuff that makes up atoms!

text: Kahuman han ginatos ka oras han operasyon an filament ha sulod han bombilya nasusunog ngan an bombilya diri na nagana.
eng_text: After hundreds of hours of operation the filament in the bulb eventually burns out and the light bulb no longer works.

text: Kinahanglan saliwanan an bombilya. Ginkikinahanglan nga maghinay ha pagliwan han bombilya.
eng_text: The light bulb then needs replacing. It is necessary to be careful in replacing the light bulb.

text: Siyahan, kinahanglan parungon an switch para ha suga o hulboton an kable.
eng_text: First, the switch for the light fixture needs to be turned off or the cable disconnected.

text: Tungod ini kay an kuryente nga naagi ngadto ha socket kon diin an metallic nga bahin han bombilya nalingkod in puydi makahatag ha imo hin grabe nga pagka-kuryente kon kakaptan mo an sulod han socket o an metal nga base han bombilya samtang ini in aada la gihapon ha socket.
eng_text: This is because electricity flowing into the socket where the metallic part of bulb sits can give you a severe electric shock if you touch the inside of the socket or the metal base of the bulb while it is still partly in the socket.

text: An nangunguna nga organ han circulatory system amo an kasingkasing, nga nagbobomba han dugo.
eng_text: The major organ of the circulatory system is the heart, which pumps the blood.

text: An dugo nagawas tikang ha aton kasingkasing ha mga tubo nga gintatawag nga mga artery ngan nabalik ha kasingkasing ha mga tubo nga gintatawag nga veins. Gintatawag an pinakagutiay nga tubo nga capillaries.
eng_text: Blood goes away from the heart in tubes called arteries and comes back to the heart in tubes called veins. The smallest tubes are called capillaries.

text: An mga ngipon han usa nga triceratop nakakapusak diri la hit mga dahon pero bisan an duro hin katig-a nga mga sanga ngan mga ugat.
eng_text: A triceratops' teeth would have been able to crush not only leaves but even very tough branches and roots.

text: Naghuhunahuna an mga sayantista nga nakaon an mga Triceratops hin mga cycads, nga usa nga klase hin tanom nga komon ha Cretaceous.
eng_text: Some scientists think Triceratops ate cycads, which are a type of plant that was common in the Cretaceous.

text: Ini nga mga tanom baga hin gutiay nga palmera nga puno nga mayda magtarom, tusok-tusok nga mga dahon.
eng_text: These plants look like a small palm tree with a crown of sharp, spiky leaves.

text: Mahimo gamiton han usa nga Triceratops an iya makusog nga tuka para tanggalon an mga dahon ugsa kaunon an puno.
eng_text: A Triceratops could have used its strong beak to strip off the leaves before eating the trunk.

text: Nangatadongan an iba nga mga sayantista nga ini nga mga tanom makahirilo hin duro asya diri gud ini kakaunon hin bisan ano nga dinosaur, bisan kon ha yana an sloth ngan iba nga mga hayop sugad han pikoy (usa nga kaliwat han mga dinosaur) puydi kumaon hin makahirilo nga mga dahon o prutas.
eng_text: Other scientists argue that these plants are very poisonous so it is unlikely that any dinosaur ate them, even though today the sloth and other animals like the parrot (a descendant of the dinosaurs) can eat poisonous leaves or fruit.

text: Paonan-o man an grabidad han Io mabunlot ha akon? Kon matindog ha bawbaw han Io, mas magaan an imo timbang kontra hit adto ka ha Tuna.
eng_text: How would Io's gravity pull on me? If you stood on the surface of Io, you would weigh less than you do on Earth.

text: An usa nga tawo nga nagtitimbang hin 200 libras (90kg) ha Tuna matimbang hin mga 36 libras (16kg) ha Io. Salit an grabidad, syempre, mas gutiay an bunlot ha imo.
eng_text: A person who weighs 200 pounds (90kg) on Earth would weigh about 36 pounds (16kg) on Io. So the gravity, of course, pulls less on you.

text: An adlaw waray crust nga sugad han Tuna nga puydi nimo matindogan. An bug-os nga Adlaw hinimo ha mga gas, kalayo, ngan plasma.
eng_text: The Sun doesn't have a crust like the Earth that you can stand on. The whole Sun is made out of gases, fire, and plasma.

text: Nagtitikanipis an gas samtang nagtitikahirayo tikang ha sentro han Adlaw.
eng_text: The gas becomes thinner as you go farther from the center of the Sun.

text: An gawas nga parte nga aton nakikit-an kon nakita kita ha Adlaw gintatawag nga photosphere, nga an karuyag sidngon "bola hin suga".
eng_text: The outer-part we see when we look at the Sun is called the photosphere, which means "ball of light".

text: Mga tulo ka yukot ka tuig na an naglabay, dida han 1610, gumamit an Italian astronomer nga hi Galileo Galilei hin usa ka teleskopyo para ma-obserbaran nga an Venus mayda mga posisyon, sugad nga mayda an bulan.
eng_text: About three thousand years later, in 1610, Italian astronomer Galileo Galilei used a telescope to observe that Venus has phases, just as the moon does.

text: Nahitatabo an mga posisyon tungod an kilid la han Venus (o han Bulan) nga naatubang ha Adlaw an nalalamragan. An mga posisyon han Venus suportado han teyoriya ni Copernicus nga an mga planeta natuyok palibot han Adlaw.
eng_text: Phases happen because only the side of Venus (or of the Moon) facing the Sun is lighted. The phases of Venus supported the theory of Copernicus that the planets go around the Sun.

text: Kahuman, pira ka tuig an naglabay dida han 1639, usa ka English nga astronomer nga gin-ngaranan nga hi Jeremiah Horrocks naka-obserbar han usa ka pagbalhin han Venus.
eng_text: Then, a few years later in 1639, an English astronomer named Jeremiah Horrocks observed a transit of Venus.

text: Gin-agian han Englatera an usa ka halawig nga panahon han kamurayaw kahuman han otro nga pagkasakop han Danelaw.
eng_text: England had experienced a long period of peace after the reconquest of the Danelaw.

text: Bisan pa dida han 991 inatubang hi Ethelred hin usa ka Viking fleet nga durudako pa kontra han bisan ano tikang han kan Guthrum nga surusayo hin usa ka siglo.
eng_text: However in 991 Ethelred was faced with a Viking fleet larger than any since Guthrum's a century earlier.

text: Ini nga fleet gin pamunuan ni Olaf Trygvasson, usa ka Norwegian nga mayada mga ambisyon hin pagbawi han iya nasyon tikang han Danish nga dominasyon.
eng_text: This fleet was led by Olaf Trygvasson, a Norwegian with ambitions to reclaim his country from Danish domination.

text: Kahuman han siyahan nga militar nga mga kapakyas, nahimo ni Ethelred nga makigsabot hin mga termino kan Olaf, nga binmalik ha Norway para sarihan nga maangkon an iya ginhadian nga mayda halo-halo nga kadaugan.
eng_text: After initial military setbacks, Ethelred was able to agree to terms with Olaf, who returned to Norway to try to gain his kingdom with mixed success.

text: An Hangeul asya la an tinuyo nga gin-imbento nga alpabeto nga sikat ha adlaw-adlaw nga paggamit. Naimbento an alpabeto dida han 1444 ha panahon han paghadi ni King Sejong (1418 – 1450).
eng_text: Hangeul is the only purposely invented alphabet in popular daily use. The alphabet was invented in 1444 during the reign of King Sejong (1418 – 1450).

text: Hi King Sejong an ika-upat nga hadi han Joseon Dynasty ngan usa han mga pinakatinahod.
eng_text: King Sejong was the fourth king of the Joseon Dynasty and is one of the most highly regarded.

text: Orihinal niya nga gin-ngaranan an Hangeul nga alpabeto hin Hunmin Jeongeum, karuyag sidngon "an sakto nga mga tunog para han pagtutdo han katawhan".
eng_text: He originally named the Hangeul alphabet Hunmin Jeongeum, which means "the correct sounds for the instruction of the people".

text: Mayda damu nga mga teyoriya ha kon paonan-o nagkaada han Sanskrit. Usa ha ira an tungod han Aryan nga pagbalhin tikang ha katundan ngadto ha India nga upod nga gindara an ira yinaknan.
eng_text: There are many theories to how Sanskrit came into existence. One of them is about an Aryan migration from the west into India who brought their language with them.

text: Usa nga kadaan nga yinaknan an Sanskrit ngan makukumpara ha Latin nga yinaknan nga ginyayakan ha Europa.
eng_text: Sanskrit is an ancient language and is comparable to the Latin language spoken in Europe.

text: An pinakauna nga nakilala nga libro ha kalibotan sinurat ha Sanskrit. Kahuman han kompilasyon han mga Upanishads, nawara na la an Sanskrit tungod han hirarkiya.
eng_text: The earliest known book in the world was written in Sanskrit. After the compilation of Upanishads, Sanskrit just faded due to hierarchy.

text: Komplikado ngan riko nga yinaknan an Sanskrit, nga nagserbi nga surok para han damu nga moderno nga Indian nga mga yinaknan, sugad nga an Latin asya an surok para han European nga mga yinaknan sugad han French ngan Spanish.
eng_text: Sanskrit is a very complex and rich language, which has served to be the source for many modern Indian languages, just like Latin is the source for European languages like French and Spanish.

text: Han tapos na an away kontra ha France, nagtikang pag-andam an Germany ha pagsakop han isla han Britanya.
eng_text: With the battle for France over, Germany began to get ready to invade the island of Britain.

text: Gin-code-name han Germany an pag-atake nga “Operation Sealion”. Kaurogan han magbug-at nga mga armas han British Army ngan mga suplay an nagkawara han pagbakwit hini tikang ha Dunkirk, salit nagin maluya an kasundalohan.
eng_text: Germany code-named the attack “Operation Sealion”. Most of the British Army's heavy weapons and supplies had been lost when it evacuated from Dunkirk, so the army was fairly weak.

text: Pero an Royal Navy mas makurukusog la gihapon kontra han German Navy (“Kriegsmarine”) ngan bangin nadestroso an bisan ano nga grupo hin magsasakop nga iginpadara ha tabok han English Channel.
eng_text: But the Royal Navy was still much stronger than the German Navy (“Kriegsmarine”) and could have destroyed any invasion fleet sent across the English Channel.

text: Bisan pa, gutiay la hin duro nga mga barko han Royal Navy an nakabase hirani han posible nga mga ruta han pagsakop tungod kay nahadlok an mga admiral nga lunuron hira han German nga pag-atake ha kahanginan.
eng_text: However, very few Royal Navy ships were based near the likely invasion routes as the admirals were afraid they would be sunk by German air attack.

text: Pagtikang kita pinaagi han pag-esplikar mahitungod han mga plano han Italya. An Italya panguna nga "little brother" han Germany ngan Japan.
eng_text: Let's start with an explanation about Italy's plans. Italy was mainly the "little brother" of Germany and Japan.

text: Mayda niya mas maluya nga kasundalohan ngan mas maluya nga navy, bisan kon nakahimo pa la hira hin upat nga bag-o nga mga barko ugsa gud la han pagtikang han gira.
eng_text: It had a weaker army and a weaker navy, although they had just built four new ships right before the beginning of the war.

text: An panguna nga mga panuyo han Italya asya an African nga mga nasud. Para madakop iton nga mga nasud, kinahanglan nira magkaada hin hugpaan hin sundalo, para an mga sundalo makaglayag ha tabok han Mediterranean Sea ngan masakop an Africa.
eng_text: Italy's main goals were African countries. To capture those countries, they would need to have a troop launching pad, so as troops could sail across the Mediterranean Sea and invade Africa.

text: Tungod hiton, kinahanglan nira tangtangon an British nga mga base ngan mga barko ha Egypt. Waray labot hiton nga mga aksyon, waray na iba nga angay buhaton an mga barko nga pan-gira hiton Italya.
eng_text: For that, they had to get rid of British bases and ships in Egypt. Besides those actions, Italy's battleships were not supposed to do anything else.

text: Yana para ha Japan. Usa an Japan nga isla nga nasud, sugad han Britain.
eng_text: Now for Japan. Japan was an island country, just like Britain.

text: An mga submarino mga barko nga gindisenyo para makabiyahe ha ilarom han tubig, ngan magpabilin didto hin maiha nga panahon.
eng_text: Submarines are ships designed to travel underwater, and remain there for an extended amount of time.

text: Gin-gamit an mga submarino han Girra ha Kalibotan I ngan Girra ha Kalibotan II. Hadto mahinay hira hin duro ngan mayda limitado hin duro nga kahirayoon hin pagtira.
eng_text: Submarines were used in World War I and World War II. Back then they were very slow and had a very limited shooting range.

text: Dida han pagtikang han girra kaurogan hira nga nabiyahe ha bawbaw han dagat, pero han nagtikang pag-uswag an radar ngan nahimo nga mas sakto napiritan an mga submarino nga magpailarom ha tubig basi diri makit-an.
eng_text: In the beginning of the war they mostly travelled on top of the sea, but as radar began developing and becoming more accurate the submarines were forced to go under water to avoid being seen.

text: An German nga mga submarino gintawag nga mga U-Boat. Duro ka magkarit an mga German ha pagnabigar ngan pagpadalagan han ira mga submarino.
eng_text: German submarines were called U-Boats. The Germans were very good at navigating and operating their submarines.

text: Tungod han ira kadaogan ha mga submarino, katapos han girra waray igtapod ha mga German nga magkamay-ada hin damu ha ira.
eng_text: Because of their success with submarines, after the war Germans aren't trusted to have many of them.

text: Oo! Hi King Tutankhamun, nga danay gin-ngangaranan nga "King Tut" o "The Boy King", an usa han pinakakilala han kadaan nga Egyptian nga mga hadi han moderno nga mga panahon.
eng_text: Yes! King Tutankhamun, sometimes referred to as "King Tut" or "The Boy King", is one of the most well known ancient Egyptian kings in modern times.

text: Makapainteres, diri hiya ginhuhunahuna nga duro kaimportante ha kadaan nga mga panahon ngan waray marekord ha mga lista han pinakakadaan nga hadi.
eng_text: Interestingly, he was not considered to be very important in ancient times and was not recorded on most ancient king lists.

text: Bisan pa, an pagkadiskubre han iya lubnganan dida han 1922 nakapahimo ha iya nga usa nga celebrity. Samtang damu nga mga lubnganan han naglabay an pinangawatan, ini nga lubnganan ginpasagdan nga waray gud paglabti.
eng_text: However, the discovery of his tomb in 1922 made him a celebrity. While many tombs of the past were robbed, this tomb was left virtually undisturbed.

text: Kaurogan han mga butang nga iginlubong upod kan Tutankhamun maopay gud an kapreserbar, upod an yinukot nga mga artefact nga hinimo tikang ha marahalon nga mga metal ngan talagsahon nga mga bato.
eng_text: Most of the items buried with Tutankhamun have been well preserved, including thousands of artefacts made from precious metals and rare stones.

text: An pagkaimbento han de-rayos nga mga kaliding nakapahimo han mga karosa ha Assyria nga mas magaan,malurulaksi, ngan mas maopay an kaandaman para makaapas han mga sundalo ngan iba nga mga karosa.
eng_text: The invention of spoke wheels made Assyrian chariots lighter, faster, and better prepared to outrun soldiers and other chariots.

text: An mga pana tikang ha ira makamaratay nga mga crossbow nakakaungot ha panagang han karibal nga mga sundalo. Dida han mga 1000 B.C., iginpakilala han mga Assyrian an pinakauna nga kabalyero.
eng_text: Arrows from their deadly crossbows could penetrate the armor of rival soldiers. About 1000 B.C., the Assyrians introduced the first cavalry.

text: An usa nga kabalyero mga kasundalohan nga nakikig-away ha luyo han kabayo. Waray pa hadto ka-imbento an montura, salit nakikig-away an Assyrian nga kabalyero ha hukas nga bungkog han ira mga kabayo.
eng_text: A cavalry is an army that fights on horseback. The saddle had not yet been invented, so the Assyrian cavalry fought on the bare backs of their horses.

text: Damu an aton kilala nga Griego nga mga politiko, mga sayantista, ngan mga artist. Posible nga an pinakilala nga tawo hini nga kultura amo hi Homer, an bantog nga buta nga parasiday, nga nagkomposo han duha nga obra-maestra han Griego nga literatura: an mga siday nga Iliad ngan Odyssey.
eng_text: We know many Greek politicians, scientists, and artists. Possibly the most known person of this culture is Homer, the legendary blind poet, who composed two masterpieces of Greek literature: the poems Iliad and Odyssey.

text: Sikat la gihapon nga mga playwright hira Sophocles ngan Aristophanes ngan ginhuhunahuna an ira mga play nga upod han pinakamagkarit nga mga trabaho ha kalibotan han literatura.
eng_text: Sophocles and Aristophanes are still popular playwrights and their plays are considered to be among the greatest works of world literature.

text: Usa pa nga sikat nga Griego amo an mathematician nga hi Pythagoras, kaurogan nga kilala para han iya sikat nga theorem mahitungod han mga relasyon han mga kilid han mga right triangle.
eng_text: Another famous Greek is a mathematician Pythagoras, mostly known for his famous theorem about relations of the sides of right triangles.

text: Mayda magkadurodilain nga mga banabana para ha kon pira gud ka tawo an nagyayakan hin Hindi. Ginbabanabana nga aada ha butnga han ikaduha ngan ikaupat nga pinaka-komon nga ginyayakan nga yinaknan ha kalibutan.
eng_text: There are varying estimates for how many people speak Hindi. It is estimated to be between the second and fourth most commonly spoken language in the world.

text: An ihap han nitibo nga mga nagyayakan magkadurodilain depende kon iihapon o diri an duok nga may kalabotan nga mga dayalekto.
eng_text: The number of native speakers varies depending on whether or not very closely related dialects are counted.

text: An mga banabana naabot tikang ha 340 ka milyon tubtob 500 ka milyon nga nagyayakan, ngan sugad kadamu han 800 ka milyon ka tawo nga nakakaintindi han yinaknan.
eng_text: Estimates range from 340 million to 500 million speakers, and as many as 800 million people can understand the language.

text: Magkapariho an bokabularyo han Hindi ngan Urdu pero magkaiba ha pagsurat; ha adlaw-adlaw nga mga paghimangraw, an mga nagyayakan han duha nga mga yinaknan kaurogan nga nakakaintindi ha kada tagsa.
eng_text: Hindi and Urdu are similar in vocabulary but different in script; in everyday conversations, speakers of both languages can usually understand each other.

text: Dida han mga ika-15 ka siglo, nailarom an norte nga Estonia ha dako nga kultural nga impluwensya han Germany.
eng_text: Around the 15th century, northern Estonia was under great cultural influence of Germany.

text: Karuyag han iba nga German nga mga monghe nga dad-on an Diyos hin mas duok ngadto han nitibo nga mga tawo, salit ira gin-imbento an Estonian nga literal nga yinaknan.
eng_text: Some German monks wanted to bring God closer to the native people, so they invented the Estonian literal language.

text: Nakabase ini ha German nga alpabeto nga gindugangan hin usa ka karakter "Õ/õ".
eng_text: It was based on the German alphabet and one character "Õ/õ" was added.

text: Ha paglabay han panahon, damu nga mga pulong nga hinuram tikang ha German an nahitampo. Asya ini an katikangan han kalamragan.
eng_text: As time passed, many words that were borrowed from German coalesced. This was the beginning of enlightenment.

text: Sugad han nabatasan, an eredero han trono makadto diretso ha militar pagkahuman han pag-eskwela.
eng_text: Traditionally, the heir to the throne would go straight into the military after finishing school.

text: Pero, kumadto hi Charles ha unibersidad ha Trinity College, Cambridge kon diin nag-eskwela hiya hin Anthropology ngan Archaeology, ngan ha urhi History, nga nakakuha hin usa ka 2:2 (usa ka mas himubo nga ikaduha ka klase hin degree).
eng_text: However, Charles went to university at Trinity College, Cambridge where he studied Anthropology and Archaeology, and later History, earning a 2:2 (a lower second class degree).

text: Hi Charles an pinakauna nga membro han British Royal Family nga gintagan hin usa nga degree.
eng_text: Charles was the first member of the British Royal Family to be awarded a degree.

text: Nag-uupod han 3% han nasud an European Turkey (sinirangan nga Thrace o Rumelia ha Balkan peninsula).
eng_text: European Turkey (eastern Thrace or Rumelia in the Balkan peninsula) includes 3% of the country.

text: An teritoryo han Turkey sobra ha 1,600 ka kilometro (1,000 mi) an kahilaba ngan 800 km (500 mi) an kahilapad, nga mayda baga hin rectangular nga porma.
eng_text: The territory of Turkey is more than 1,600 kilometres (1,000 mi) long and 800 km (500 mi) wide, with a roughly rectangular shape.

text: An kahaluag han Turkey, nag-uupod hin mga lanaw, nag-ookupar hin 783,562 ka kilometro kwadrado (300,948 sq mi), kon diin 755,688 ka kilometro kwadrado (291,773 sq mi) an aadto ha sur katundan han Asia ngan 23,764 kilometro kwadrado (9,174 sq mi) ha Europe.
eng_text: Turkey's area, including lakes, occupies 783,562 square kilometres (300,948 sq mi), of which 755,688 square kilometres (291,773 sq mi) are in south west Asia and 23,764 square kilometres (9,174 sq mi) in Europe.

text: An kahaluag han Turkey nakakapahimo ha iya nga ika-37 nga pinakadaku nga nasud ha kalibotan, ngan sugad-sugad kadaku han Metropolitan France ngan han United Kingdom nga gintampo.
eng_text: Turkey's area makes it the world's 37th-largest country, and is about the size of Metropolitan France and the United Kingdom combined.

text: Gililibutan an Turkey hin mga dagat ha tulo nga ligid: an Aegean Sea ha katundan, an Black Sea ha norte ngan Mediterranean Sea ha sur.
eng_text: Turkey is encircled by seas on three sides: the Aegean Sea to the west, the Black Sea to the north and the Mediterranean Sea to the south.

text: An Luxembourg mayda hilaba nga kasaysayan pero an iya independensya nagpepetsa tikang pa han 1839.
eng_text: Luxembourg has a long history but its independence dates from 1839.

text: An mga bahin han Belgium ha pagkayana mga bahin anay han Luxembourg hadto pero nahimo nga Belgian pagkatapos han 1830s nga Belgian Revolution.
eng_text: Present-day parts of Belgium were part of Luxembourg in the past but became Belgian after the 1830s Belgian Revolution.

text: Nagsasari pirme an Luxembourg nga magpabilin nga usa nga neutral nga nasud pero ginsakop ini han Germany dida han pareho nga Girra ha Kalibotan I ngan Girra ha Kalibotan II.
eng_text: Luxembourg has always tried to remain a neutral country but it was occupied in both World War I and World War II by Germany.

text: Dida han 1957 nahimo an Luxembourg nga usa ka founding member han organisasyon nga kilala yana sugad nga European Union.
eng_text: In 1957 Luxembourg became a founding member of the organization which is today known as the European Union.

text: An Drukgyal Dzong usa ka narun-og nga balwarte ngan Buddhist nga monasteryo ha igbaw nga bahin han Paro District (ha Phondey Village).
eng_text: The Drukgyal Dzong is a ruined fortress and Buddhist monastery in the upper part of the Paro District (in Phondey Village).

text: Ginsisiring nga dida han 1649, ginhimo ni Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyel an balwarte para paghinumdom han iya kadaogan kontra han Tibetan-Mongol nga mga pwersa.
eng_text: It is said that in 1649, Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyel created the fortress to commemorate his victory against the Tibetan-Mongol forces.

text: Dida han 1951, usa nga sunog an nagin hinungdan para pipira na la han mga relic han Drukgyal Dzong an nahabilin, sugad han imahe ni Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyal.
eng_text: In 1951, a fire caused for only some of the relics of the Drukgyal Dzong to remain, such as the image of Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyal.

text: Kahuman han sunog, ginpreserbar ngan ginpanalipdan an balwarte, nagpapabilin nga usa han pinaka makatarag-ob nga mga atraksyon.
eng_text: After the fire, the fortress was preserved and protected, remaining to be one of Bhutan's most sensational attractions.

text: Dida han ika-18 ka siglo nakit-an han Cambodia an iya kalugaringon nga naiipit ha butnga han duha nga gamhanan nga mga amyaw, Thailand ngan Vietnam.
eng_text: During the 18th century Cambodia found itself squeezed between two powerful neighbors, Thailand and Vietnam.

text: Ginsakop han mga Thai an Cambodia makapira ka beses dida han ika-18 ka siglo ngan dida han 1772 ira ginbungkag an Phnom Phen.
eng_text: The Thais invaded Cambodia several times in the 18th century and in 1772 they destroyed Phnom Phen.

text: Han kataposan nga mga tuig han ika-18 ka siglo ginsakop gihap han Vietnamese an Cambodia.
eng_text: In the last years of the 18th century the Vietnamese also invaded Cambodia.

text: Dise-otso porsyento han mga Venezuelan an waray trabaho, ngan kaurogan hadton mga may trabaho an natrabaho ha impormal nga ekonomiya.
eng_text: Eighteen percent of Venezuelans are unemployed, and most of those who are employed work in the informal economy.

text: Duha ha tulo ka bahin han mga taga-Venezuela nga nagtatrabaho an aada ha sektor han serbisyo, hirani usa ka quarter an natrabaho ha industriya ngan an ika-lima natrabaho ha agrikultura.
eng_text: Two thirds of Venezuelans who work do so in the service sector, nearly a quarter work in industry and a fifth work in agriculture.

text: Usa nga importante nga industriya para ha mga taga-Venezuela amo an lana, kon diin an nasud usa ka net exporter, bisan kon usa ka porsyento la an natrabaho ha industriya han lana.
eng_text: An important industry for Venezuelans is oil, where the country is a net exporter, even though only one percent work in the oil industry.

text: Sayo dida han independensya han nasud, nakabulig an kakarit han mga Botanic Garden han Singapore para mahimo an isla nga usa nga tropical nga Garden City.
eng_text: Early in the nation's independence, Singapore Botanic Gardens' expertise helped to transform the island into a tropical Garden City.

text: Dida han 1981, an Vanda Miss Joaquim, usa nga hybrid nga orchid, ginpili sugad nga nasyonal nga bukad han nasud.
eng_text: In 1981, Vanda Miss Joaquim, an orchid hybrid, was chosen as the nation's national flower.

text: Kada tuig hit mga Oktubre hirani 1.5 ka milyon nga mga herbivore an nabiyahe tikadto ha sur nga kapatagan, natalabok ha Mara River, tikang ha norte nga kabungtoran para han mga uran.
eng_text: Every year around October nearly 1.5 million herbivores travel towards the southern plains, crossing the Mara River, from the northern hills for the rains.

text: Ngan katima nabalik liwat ngadto ha norte pinaagi han katundan, utro nga natalabok ha Mara river, kahuman han mga pag-uran ha Abril.
eng_text: And then back to the north through the west, once again crossing the Mara river, after the rains in around April.

text: An Serengeti nga rehiyon nagsusulod han Serengeti National Park, an Ngorongoro Conservation Area ngan Maswa Game Reserve ha Tanzania ngan an Maasai Mara National Reserve ha Kenya.
eng_text: The Serengeti region contains the Serengeti National Park, the Ngorongoro Conservation Area and Maswa Game Reserve in Tanzania and the Maasai Mara National Reserve in Kenya.

text: An paghibaro para makahimo hin interactive media nagkikinahanglan hin nahiaraan ngan kinadaan nga mga kaabtik, sugad gihapon han mga garamiton nga gin-aadman ha interactive nga mga klase (storyboarding, audio ngan video editing, pagsumat hin istorya, etc.)
eng_text: Learning to create interactive media requires conventional and traditional skills, as well as tools mastered in interactive classes (storyboarding, audio and video editing, story telling, etc.)

text: An interactive nga disenyo nagkikinahanglan nga utro nimo nga panginanoon an imo mga ginhuhunahuna tungod han media production ngan mahibaro ha paghunahuna ha diri-nalilinya nga mga paagi.
eng_text: Interactive design requires that you re-assess your assumptions about media production and learn to think in a non-linear ways.

text: An interactive nga disenyo nagkikinahanglan nga an mga bahin han usa nga proyekto konektado ha kada tagsa, pero mayda gihapon kahulogan sugad nga usa nga lain nga butang.
eng_text: Interactive design requires that components of a project connect to each other, but also make sense as a separate entity.

text: An disbentaha han mga zoom lens amo nga an focal nga pagka-komplikado ngan ihap han mga elemento han lens nga kinahanglanon para maabot an kahilapad han focal nga mga kahilabaon mas daku kontra han para ha mga prime lens.
eng_text: The disadvantage of zoom lenses is that the focal complexity and number of lens elements required to achieve a range of focal lengths is much greater than for prime lenses.

text: Nagtitikaminos na ini nga isyu tungod kay nakakaabot na an mga parahimo hin lens hin mas hitaas nga mga standard ha paghimo hin lens.
eng_text: This is becoming less of an issue as lens manufacturers achieve higher standards in lens production.

text: Gintugotan hini an mga zoom lens nga makahimo hin mga litrato nga mayda kalidad nga puydi maikompara hiton naaabot han mga lens nga mayda permanente nga focal nga kahilaba.
eng_text: This has allowed zoom lenses to produce pictures of a quality comparable to that achieved by lenses with fixed focal length.

text: Usa pa nga disbentaha han mga zoom lens amo nga an pinakadaku nga aperture (an kalaksi) han lens kaurogan nga mas hamubo.
eng_text: Another disadvantage of zoom lenses is that the maximum aperture (the speed) of the lens is usually lower.

text: Nakakapakuri ini ha baratuhon nga mga zoom lens nga gamiton ha masirom nga mga kondisyon nga waray flash.
eng_text: This makes inexpensive zoom lenses hard to use in low-light conditions without a flash.

text: Usa han pinaka-kumon nga mga problema kun nagsasari pagbalhin hin usa ka salida tikadto ha DVD nga pormat amo an overscan.
eng_text: One of the most common problems when trying to convert a movie to DVD format is the overscan.

text: Kaurog han mga telebisyon ginhimo ha pamaagi para lipayon an kabug-usan nga publiko.
eng_text: Most televisions are made in a way to please the general public.

text: Para hiton nga rason, tanan nga imo nakikit-an ha TV gin-utod an mga border, igbaw, ubos ngan mga ligid.
eng_text: For that reason, everything you see on the TV had the borders cut, top, bottom and sides.

text: Ginhihimo ini para masiguro nga masakop han imahe an bug-os nga screen. Overscan an tawag hiton.
eng_text: This is made to ensure that the image covers the whole screen. That is called overscan.

text: Ha kawaray palad, kun naghihimo ka hin DVD, dako it tsansa nga mautod gihapon an iya mga border, ngan kun harani hin duro ha ubos an mga subtitle han video, diri ini bug-os nga makit-an.
eng_text: Unfortunately, when you make a DVD, it's borders will most likely be cut too, and if the video had subtitles too close to the bottom, they won't be fully shown.

text: An tradisyonal nga medyebal nga palasyo maiha na nga pinukaw an imahinasyon, panhunahuna hin mga ladawan han mga bulang hin mga kabalyero, mga piyesta ngan Arthurian nga dungog han pagkakabalyero.
eng_text: The traditional medieval castle has long inspired the imagination, conjuring up images of jousts, banquets and Arthurian chivalry.

text: Bisan natindog ha butnga hin yukot ka tuig nga mga kagubaan madali la hinumdoman an tunog ngan amyon han awayan nga maiha na nga nawara, haros bati-on iton aringasa han siki dida han kabatohan ngan maamyon an kahadlok tikang han buho ha prisohan.
eng_text: Even standing amidst thousand year-old ruins it is easy to bring to mind the sounds and smells of battles long gone, to almost hear the clatter of hooves on the cobbles and to smell the fear rising from the dungeon pits.

text: Pero iton aton imahinasyon base ba hin reyalidad? Kay ano nga ginhimo an mga palasyo ha syahan nga bahin? Paunan-o hira gin desinyo ngan ginhimo?
eng_text: But is our imagination based on reality? Why were castles built in the first place? How were they designed and built?

text: Komon para han panahon, an Kirby Muxloe Castle mas labaw nga usa nga ginparig-on nga balay kay ha usa ka tinuod nga kastilyo.
eng_text: Typical for the period, Kirby Muxloe Castle is more of a fortified house than a true castle.

text: An iya daku nga mainggat nga mga bintana ngan manipis nga mga bungbong diri makakailob pagpugong hin usa ka determinado nga pag-atake hin maiha.
eng_text: Its large glazed windows and thin walls would not have been able to resist a determined attack for long.

text: Dida han 1480s, han nagtikang ini tukuron ni Lord Hastings, medyo murayaw pa an nasud ngan an depensa kinahanglanon la kontra han gudti nga mga grupo hin nagliyong-liyong nga mga tulisan.
eng_text: In the 1480s, when its construction was begun by Lord Hastings, the country was relatively peaceful and defense was only required against small bands of roving marauders.

text: An balanse han gahum usa nga sistema nga ginhihingita han European nga mga nasud basi mamintinar an soberanya han tanan nga European nga mga estado.
eng_text: The balance of power was a system in which European nations sought to maintain the national sovereignty of all European states.

text: An konsepto amo nga tanan nga European nga mga nasud kinahanglan magbantay para mapugngan an usa nga nasud nga mahimo nga gamhanan, ngan salit an nasyonal nga mga gobyerno sukot magliwan han ira mga alyansa para mamintinar an balanse.
eng_text: The concept was that all European nations had to seek to prevent one nation from becoming powerful, and thus national governments often changed their alliances in order to maintain the balance.

text: An Girra han Spanish Succession nagtitigaman han siyahan nga girra kon diin an sentral nga isyu amo an balanse han gahum.
eng_text: The War of Spanish Succession marked the first war whose central issue was the balance of power.

text: Nagtitigaman ini han usa nga importante nga pagbag-o, tungod kay an European nga mga gahum waray na pasangil ha pagin relihiyoso nga mga girra. Salit, an Traynta ka Tuig nga Girra amo an kataposan nga girra nga ginmarkahan sugad nga usa nga relihiyoso nga girra.
eng_text: This marked an important change, as European powers would no longer have the pretext of being religious wars. Thus, the Thirty Years' War would be the last war to be labeled a religious war.

text: Nabungkag an templo ni Artemis ha Ephesus dida han Hulyo 21, 356 BCE pinaagi han arson nga ginbuhat ni Herostratus.
eng_text: The temple of Artemis at Ephesus was destroyed on July 21, 356 BCE in an act of arson committed by Herostratus.

text: Sumala han istorya, an iya motibasyon amo an pagin sikat bisan ano man an magin kabalyo. Ha kasinahon han mga Ephesians, ira igin-anunsyo nga diri igrekord an ngaran ni Herostratus bisan san-o.
eng_text: According to the story, his motivation was fame at any cost. The Ephesians, outraged, announced that Herostratus' name never be recorded.

text: Ha urhi gintigamnan han Griego nga historyador nga hi Strabo an ngaran, nga amo an paagi nga nahibaro kita yana. Ginbungkag an templo ha pariho nga gab-i nga natawo hi Alexander the Great.
eng_text: The Greek historian Strabo later noted the name, which is how we know today. The temple was destroyed on the same night that Alexander the Great was born.

text: Sugad usa nga hadi, nagtanyag hi Alexander nga baydan an pagpaayad utro han templo, pero ginbalibaran an iya tanyag. Ha kaurhian, kahuman han pagkamatay ni Alexander, utro nga gintindog an templo dida han 323 BCE.
eng_text: Alexander, as king, offered to pay to rebuild the temple, but his offer was denied. Later, after Alexander died, the temple was rebuilt in 323 BCE.

text: Siguroha nga sugad ka relaks tubtob ha mahimo an imo kamot samtang sakto nga gin-iigo an tanan nga mga nota - sarihi gihapon nga diri maghimo hin sobra-sobra nga mga pagkiwa han imo mga tudlo.
eng_text: Make sure your hand is as relaxed as possible while still hitting all the notes correctly - also try not to make much extraneous motion with your fingers.

text: Hini nga paagi, gutiay hinduro an posibilidad nga kakapuyon ka. Hinumdumi nga diri nimo kinahanglan igoon an mga key hin duro nga kusog para han dugang nga volume sugad han ha piano.
eng_text: This way, you will tire yourself out as little as possible. Remember there's no need to hit the keys with a lot of force for extra volume like on the piano.

text: Ha accordion, para makakuha hin dugang nga volume, nagamit ka hin dugang nga presyon o kalaksi ha mga bellows.
eng_text: On the accordion, to get extra volume, you use the bellows with more pressure or speed.

text: An mistisismo amo an pagpamiling han pagkahiusa han, pangirilal-an han, o an sayod nga pagkahibaro han ultimo nga kamatuoran, pagkadiyosnon, espiritwal nga kamatuoran, o Diyos.
eng_text: Mysticism is the pursuit of communion with, identity with, or conscious awareness of an ultimate reality, divinity, spiritual truth, or God.

text: An tumuroo namimiling hin direkta nga eksperyensya, pagkahibaro, o sulod nga panlantaw ngadto han diyosnon nga kamatuoran/an diyos o mga diyos.
eng_text: The believer seeks a direct experience, intuition, or insight into divine reality/the deity or dieties.

text: An mga sumurunod nagbibiling hin piho nga mga paagi han pag-ukoy, o mga buruhaton nga gintuyo para mapauswag iton nga mga eksperyensya.
eng_text: Followers pursue certain ways of living, or practices that are intended to nurture those experiences.

text: An mistisismo puydi makilal-an tikang ha iba nga mga porma han relihiyoso nga pagtoo ngan pagsingba pinaagi han iya paghatag hin pagpabug-at ha direkta nga personal nga eksperyensya han talagsahon nga kasayod, partikular adton usa ka murayaw, hilarom nga pagsabot, mahimyang, o bisan pa mahimayaon nga kinaiya.
eng_text: Mysticism can be distinguished from other forms of religious belief and worship by its emphasis on the direct personal experience of a unique state of consciousness, particularly those of a peaceful, insightful, blissful, or even ecstatic character.

text: An Sikhism usa nga relihiyon tikang ha sub-continent han India. Nagtikang ini ha Punjab nga rehiyon dida han ika-15 nga siglo tikang ha usa nga sectarian nga pagbulag ha sulod han Hindu nga tradisyon.
